sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Fertilizers is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Hey there. See what’s going on? Bitcoin plunges into the abyss. I don’t know if that’s a conspiracy or a logical pattern. This whole business was shady from the start, but well, there’s nothing left to do but to salvage what we can. To cut the long story short, my farm is acting up lately - bugs, freezes, and everything. Fix me up with some wires and capacitors. I have a little idea on how to improve the system stability. And make sure it's all new and untouched!"

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - Must be level 30 to start this quest.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Find 5 Bundle of wires in raid
- Find 5 Capacitors in raid
- Handover 5 Bundle of wires to Mechanic
- Handover 5 Capacitors to Mechanic

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +17,200 EXP
- Mechanic Rep +0.01
- 40,000 Roubles
  - 42,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 46,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 2× Physical Bitcoin
- Unlocks purchase of HK USP .45 ACP pistol (variant Match) at Mechanic LL3
"Now we’re talking! I’ll grab a soldering iron and get to work. Perhaps the market's gonna stabilize already by that time."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
Wires and capacitors can most commonly be found in PC blocks, in tech stores on Interchange such as TechLight, Texho, or Rasmussen, they can also be crafted in the hideout.
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |
| Bundle of wires | 5 | Handover item | Yes | Can be crafted in the Hideout (Workbench lv. 1). |
| Capacitors | 5 | Handover item | Yes | Can be crafted in the Hideout (Workbench lv. 1). |
